Documentation.long_help: Read an omega_h mesh. An omega_h mesh is stored as a directory ending in .osh: ASCII 'nparts' and 'version' sidecar files plus one binary part file per writer rank. The reader parses the binary format itself and loads each part as a partition of a partitioned dataset.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The directory containing the omega_h mesh (e.g. /path/to/mesh.osh).
